annotations.title: What the stores turned down, and why

description: Everything the App Store and Google Play said when they turned something down, in one place: the App Store version (REJECTED, METADATA_REJECTED, INVALID_BINARY), builds Apple's processing refused, TestFlight beta review, in-app purchases and subscriptions, in-app events, custom product pages and tests, Google Play releases its review didn't approve, and releases or approved requests the store refused on the way. Each with its state, when, every reason the stores' APIs give, the message the person pasted from App Store Connect or Play Console with its guideline numbers and ITMS codes, the link where the full text is, and what to do next. Apple's API has no App Review message or guideline numbers, and Google's none for policy rejections: when the person gives you that text, pass it as text (with item, the rejection's key from this tool, or store) and Ploa keeps it with the rejection, in the audit log. Start here when an app was rejected.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask the stores again instead of the answer from the last ten minutes.

item.description: Which rejection the text belongs to: its key from this tool (like apple:version:…). Leave out for the store's newest.

note.description: With translations: the id of a message already kept (shown as note … in this tool's answer).

store.description: With text and no item: whose message it is.

text.description: The store's message as the person copied it (App Store Connect › App Review, or Play Console's Inbox), to keep in Ploa. Up to 20000 characters.

translations.description: The message translated, for people who read Ploa in that language; the store's own text is kept as it is. With text, or with note for a message already kept.

he.description: The message in Hebrew, faithful and complete, guideline numbers and names of things left as they are.

name: ploa_review_rejection
